text.text_excerpt: I'm absolutely obsessed with this place, I want to eat through the whole menu. It's one of only fresh sandwich and salad lunch place in the city, and they have tons of great veggie options. I like getting the avocado club (not on the menu), a double decker sandwich with lots of avocado, sprouts, tomato and swiss cheese. I'm also a huge fan of the spinach salad, stuffed avocado salad with shrimp or egg salad inside, the gumbo and always get their delicious southern style potato salad on the side. Their portions are fairly large, often more than enough for one meal. They also have a big selection of salad dressings that they make themselves, a huge plus. Overall, this is one of your best be...

This review is for their deliveries only. I've been having their food delivered the last 4 years I've been working in the CBD. I've never actually been in their restaurant. They offer healthy lunch choices for a good price. It's not the "typical" New Orleans foods. It actually reminds me more of back in California. Some of their sandwiches have avocado and sprouts...yum! My favorite things to order are: any of the sandwiches or melts, the turkey burger, turkey tacos, stuffed avocado salad and the veggie stir-fry. I love this place, it's it's a hidden gem! The food is always fresh and delicious. I used to explore different items on the menu, but for the past 3 years or so all I've gotten is a chicken salad salad or a chicken salad sandwich! The chicken salad is to die for. I love the tamari & oil dressing too. They deliver and you can write a check for your delivery or pay be credit card on the phone.
